messages:
Aisha Patel: Quick heads-up — leadership approved a pilot for short-term rotations into Platform Capacity to cover near-term throughput work while we recruit. We need two engineers from eng-sre for 6-week paired rotations (focus: autoscaler perf, routing fallback, KV cache visibility). Start target: 2026-04-20. Also we hired a contract Senior Platform Engineer, Kenji Sato, for 6 months to help stabilize rollout bandwidth. Hiring doc + access plan: https://redwood-internal/company/hiring/platform-rotations
Kenji Sato: Hi everyone — excited to join Redwood. I start onboarding week of 2026-04-13, remote-first. @Jen Morales can you ping the onboarding form? I'll get my laptop and KMS access sorted.
Tom Granger: We can rotate Mei and Carlos for the first wave. I'll work with them on handoffs and make sure runbooks are current. @Maya Li can you confirm the priority bucket so we scope the 6 weeks?
Maya Li: Confirmed — priority order for the rotation: 1) autoscaler perf investigations and mitigations 2) routing fallback automation for regional failures 3) improved KV cache telemetry + dashboards. Appreciate the short runway, Aisha :rocket:
Jen Morales: Welcome, @Kenji! Onboarding checklist (quick):
- fill the new-hire form: https://redwood-internal/selfserve/onboard
- laptop + VPN ticket (IT) — I'll open with hardware team
- KMS/HSM access approval (security) — I'll route the request
I'll schedule a 30m intro with Platform PM and Aisha for next week.
oncall-bot: POLICY REMINDER: rotation engineers must request a rollout review before changing prod routing or autoscaler configs. See: https://redwood-internal/policies/rollout-review
Carlos Ruiz: Happy to join rotation 1, can start Apr 20. Tom — I'll sync with you on the autoscaler checklist this week. Any doc pointers welcome.
Mei Chen: Same here — will pair with Carlos for the first two weeks for knowledge transfer. I'll add the runbook updates to the platform docs repo and open PRs for missing sections.
Aisha Patel: Thanks all. I'll publish the rotation calendar + pairing schedule tomorrow and attach invites. Tentative schedule snippet:
``` 
Rotation 1 (Apr 20 - Jun 01): Carlos Ruiz + Mei Chen
Kenji Sato (contract): onboard Apr 13 - ongoing through Oct 2026
Rotation checkpoints: weekly sync (Wednesdays 10am PT), handoff doc due end of week 4
```
Tom Granger: Perfect. I'll also flag any capacity risks in the Friday triage and tag @eng-sre-leads.
Jen Morales: Added Kenji to payroll contract queue and opened IT ticket. I'll post final calendar invites once Aisha shares the schedule. :white_check_mark:
Aisha Patel: Great momentum — thanks team. We'll keep this lightweight and iterate after the first rotation.
